Vendored from the published typescript@5.9.3 package via unpkg:
lib/typescript.js, LICENSE.txt, ThirdPartyNoticeText.txt.
lib.es2020.full.d.ts and its referenced lib.*.d.ts dependencies are bundled
for editor inference. libs.json lists those files for the autocomplete worker.
No compiler code or editor source is fetched at runtime.
